summary.biological_description: Interferon / MHC response captures inflammatory, antiviral, and antigen-presentation activity within the parent cell type.
summary.curation_notes: Shared type I interferon program, not dendritic-cell specific.
summary.do_not_overinterpret_as: a distinct immune cell identity unless parent-cell assignment supports it
summary.gene_expression_caveat: Expression in this state does not by itself prove the gene is immune-specific or causal for inflammation. Some IFN/MHC signals can track sample inflammation, immune-cell proximity, or HLA-rich ambient RNA.
summary.gene_expression_followup: Check expression in immune cells, QC-sensitive states, IFN/MHC-matched programs, and PIGEAN trait anchors for autoimmune or inflammatory traits.
summary.gene_expression_interpretation: If your gene is enriched here, it may be linked to inflammatory signaling, cytokine response, antigen presentation, or immune-mediated stress in this cell type.
summary.gene_expression_overinterpretation_warni: Do not interpret enrichment alone as evidence that the parent cell has become an immune cell or that the gene directly causes immune activation.
summary.interpretation_caveat: This can be real inflammatory biology, but immune contamination, HLA-high ambient RNA, and doublets should be checked.
summary.portal_methods_details: Score scope: within_tissue_cell_type; Hard-call policy: Use continuous activity scores by default. Hard calls require separate score-distribution validation.; QC sensitivity: moderate; Supporting evidence for assigning cells: high IFN/MHC activity; parent identity retained; low immune contamination/doublet scores
summary.portal_user_summary: Interferon / MHC response reflects inflammatory, antiviral, and antigen-presentation activity in the parent cell type.
summary.recommended_portal_summary: A well-established inflammatory process score, best interpreted as a continuous gradient.
summary.required_supporting_evidence: high IFN/MHC activity; parent identity retained; low immune contamination/doublet scores
summary.short_description: Interferon / MHC response captures inflammatory, antiviral, and antigen-presentation activity within the parent cell type.

summary.biological_description: Interferon / MHC response captures inflammatory, antiviral, and antigen-presentation activity within the parent cell type.
summary.curation_notes: Activated pDC/type I interferon state; lowly detected interferon genes may be sparse.
summary.do_not_overinterpret_as: a distinct immune cell identity unless parent-cell assignment supports it
summary.gene_expression_caveat: Expression in this state does not by itself prove the gene is immune-specific or causal for inflammation. Some IFN/MHC signals can track sample inflammation, immune-cell proximity, or HLA-rich ambient RNA.
summary.gene_expression_followup: Check expression in immune cells, QC-sensitive states, IFN/MHC-matched programs, and PIGEAN trait anchors for autoimmune or inflammatory traits.
summary.gene_expression_interpretation: If your gene is enriched here, it may be linked to inflammatory signaling, cytokine response, antigen presentation, or immune-mediated stress in this cell type.
summary.gene_expression_overinterpretation_warni: Do not interpret enrichment alone as evidence that the parent cell has become an immune cell or that the gene directly causes immune activation.
summary.interpretation_caveat: This can be real inflammatory biology, but immune contamination, HLA-high ambient RNA, and doublets should be checked.
summary.portal_methods_details: Score scope: within_tissue_cell_type; Hard-call policy: Use continuous activity scores by default. Hard calls require separate score-distribution validation.; QC sensitivity: moderate; Supporting evidence for assigning cells: high IFN/MHC activity; parent identity retained; low immune contamination/doublet scores
summary.portal_user_summary: Interferon / MHC response reflects inflammatory, antiviral, and antigen-presentation activity in the parent cell type.
summary.recommended_portal_summary: A well-established inflammatory process score, best interpreted as a continuous gradient.
summary.required_supporting_evidence: high IFN/MHC activity; parent identity retained; low immune contamination/doublet scores
summary.short_description: Interferon / MHC response captures inflammatory, antiviral, and antigen-presentation activity within the parent cell type.

summary.biological_description: Interferon / MHC response captures inflammatory, antiviral, and antigen-presentation activity within the parent cell type.
summary.curation_notes: Shared type I interferon program, not T-cell specific.
summary.do_not_overinterpret_as: a distinct immune cell identity unless parent-cell assignment supports it
summary.gene_expression_caveat: Expression in this state does not by itself prove the gene is immune-specific or causal for inflammation. Some IFN/MHC signals can track sample inflammation, immune-cell proximity, or HLA-rich ambient RNA.
summary.gene_expression_followup: Check expression in immune cells, QC-sensitive states, IFN/MHC-matched programs, and PIGEAN trait anchors for autoimmune or inflammatory traits.
summary.gene_expression_interpretation: If your gene is enriched here, it may be linked to inflammatory signaling, cytokine response, antigen presentation, or immune-mediated stress in this cell type.
summary.gene_expression_overinterpretation_warni: Do not interpret enrichment alone as evidence that the parent cell has become an immune cell or that the gene directly causes immune activation.
summary.interpretation_caveat: This can be real inflammatory biology, but immune contamination, HLA-high ambient RNA, and doublets should be checked.
summary.portal_methods_details: Score scope: within_tissue_cell_type; Hard-call policy: Use continuous activity scores by default. Hard calls require separate score-distribution validation.; QC sensitivity: moderate; Supporting evidence for assigning cells: high IFN/MHC activity; parent identity retained; low immune contamination/doublet scores
summary.portal_user_summary: Interferon / MHC response reflects inflammatory, antiviral, and antigen-presentation activity in the parent cell type.
summary.recommended_portal_summary: A well-established inflammatory process score, best interpreted as a continuous gradient.
summary.required_supporting_evidence: high IFN/MHC activity; parent identity retained; low immune contamination/doublet scores
summary.short_description: Interferon / MHC response captures inflammatory, antiviral, and antigen-presentation activity within the parent cell type.

summary.biological_description: Interferon / MHC response captures inflammatory, antiviral, and antigen-presentation activity within the parent cell type.
summary.curation_notes: Generic type-I interferon response program.
summary.do_not_overinterpret_as: a distinct immune cell identity unless parent-cell assignment supports it
summary.gene_expression_caveat: Expression in this state does not by itself prove the gene is immune-specific or causal for inflammation. Some IFN/MHC signals can track sample inflammation, immune-cell proximity, or HLA-rich ambient RNA.
summary.gene_expression_followup: Check expression in immune cells, QC-sensitive states, IFN/MHC-matched programs, and PIGEAN trait anchors for autoimmune or inflammatory traits.
summary.gene_expression_interpretation: If your gene is enriched here, it may be linked to inflammatory signaling, cytokine response, antigen presentation, or immune-mediated stress in this cell type.
summary.gene_expression_overinterpretation_warni: Do not interpret enrichment alone as evidence that the parent cell has become an immune cell or that the gene directly causes immune activation.
summary.interpretation_caveat: This can be real inflammatory biology, but immune contamination, HLA-high ambient RNA, and doublets should be checked.
summary.portal_methods_details: Score scope: within_tissue_cell_type; Hard-call policy: Use continuous activity scores by default. Hard calls require separate score-distribution validation.; QC sensitivity: moderate; Supporting evidence for assigning cells: high IFN/MHC activity; parent identity retained; low immune contamination/doublet scores
summary.portal_user_summary: Interferon / MHC response reflects inflammatory, antiviral, and antigen-presentation activity in the parent cell type.
summary.recommended_portal_summary: A well-established inflammatory process score, best interpreted as a continuous gradient.
summary.required_supporting_evidence: high IFN/MHC activity; parent identity retained; low immune contamination/doublet scores
summary.short_description: Interferon / MHC response captures inflammatory, antiviral, and antigen-presentation activity within the parent cell type.

summary.curation_notes: Generic cell-cycle program within NK cells.
summary.do_not_overinterpret_as: a new subtype or a disease-specific program by itself

summary.gene_expression_followup: Check whether the gene is a known cell-cycle gene and whether the association persists outside broadly cycling programs.
summary.gene_expression_interpretation: If your gene is enriched here, it may be associated with cell-cycle activity, proliferative expansion, or cycling subpopulations of the selected cell type.
summary.gene_expression_overinterpretation_warni: Do not interpret enrichment alone as a disease-specific proliferation mechanism.
summary.interpretation_caveat: The marker panel is generic across cell types. Hard calls are only appropriate if the score distribution supports a separable cycling population.
summary.portal_methods_details: Score scope: within_tissue_cell_type; Hard-call policy: Use continuous activity scores by default. summary.recommended_portal_summary: A well-established cell-cycle process. Can be hard-callable when score distributions separate.
summary.required_supporting_evidence: high cell-cycle activity; adequate marker coverage; separable score distribution; parent identity retained

summary.gene_expression_caveat: Expression in this state does not by itself prove the gene is immune-specific or causal for inflammation. Some IFN/MHC signals can track sample inflammation, immune-cell proximity, or HLA-rich ambient RNA.
summary.gene_expression_followup: Check expression in immune cells, QC-sensitive states, IFN/MHC-matched programs, and PIGEAN trait anchors for autoimmune or inflammatory traits.
summary.gene_expression_interpretation: If your gene is enriched here, it may be linked to inflammatory signaling, cytokine response, antigen presentation, or immune-mediated stress in this cell type.
summary.gene_expression_overinterpretation_warni: Do not interpret enrichment alone as evidence that the parent cell has become an immune cell or that the gene directly causes immune activation.
summary.interpretation_caveat: This can be real inflammatory biology, but immune contamination, HLA-high ambient RNA, and doublets should be checked.
summary.portal_methods_details: Score scope: within_tissue_cell_type; Hard-call policy: Use continuous activity scores by default. summary.recommended_portal_summary: A well-established inflammatory process score, best interpreted as a continuous gradient.
summary.required_supporting_evidence: high IFN/MHC activity; parent identity retained; low immune contamination/doublet scores

summary.recommended_portal_summary: A well-established cell-cycle process. Can be hard-callable when score distributions separate.
